notes.notes:
Hey Future-Dwellers!

Since we launched 1.0 we've been reading all of the feedback, suggestions and bug reports. Today we released the next hofix that fixes a range of major issues you were encountering.

Stuttering issues:
We decreased the stuttering issues you may have encountered so the overall gameplay and performance should feel a lot smoother. We’re continuing our work on these kinds of issues and will improve them even more with future updates.

Achievements: 

 “Spring Cleaning” is now fixed.

Minions:

 Bug with the close button in the minion menu fixed.
 Fixed problems with minions recharging mechanics.
 Fixed problem with minions infinite watering.
 Fixed some pathfinding issues.
 Fixed pathfinding issues near the recharge pool.
 Fixed repair visual effect.

Other:

 Fixed issue with an empty workbench window.
 Some dishes now do not require fire to be cooked now.
 Fixed some issues with building on some roof areas.
 Fixed some issues with floor patch mechanics.
 Fixed leeches after save/load and under-floor issues.
 Minor UI fixes.
 Improved overall game stability.
 Added nanoforge sounds.
 Removed the ability to eat biomass while the generator window opened. 
 Fixed some localization issues
 Added workaround for a situation when you do not have enough disk space for the game to be saved correctly
 Added Barbara's emotion sounds

The development team is working hard to release updates as soon as possible, but we need a little more time between patches to ensure they fully fix the issues and don't create any new ones! 
Did we miss anything? Let us know in our discussions or in the comments in this post and let us know.

Thanks for being patient with us and your continued support 💙

notes.title: 💙 VERSION 1.0 IS COMING!!🚀
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/3d7d7917a753122eeec6d55d55a051aa760eff71.png

💙RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT!!🚀

Version 1.0 will be coming to your rooftop on NOVEMBER 13th!

Watch our devlog to see what's coming in our biggest update yet 👇

[previewyoutube=MCpwjJQl578;full][/previewyoutube]

TEXT VERSION OF THE UPDATE: 

Story
At last, you’ll be able to complete the story, discover what happened to Cosmopolis and our hero, and make an important choice!

New Rooftops
Remember all those "coming soon" zones? Well now, you’ll be able to visit all the rooftops you’ve been curious about, plus we’ve added several bigger new locations!

The Carnival
We know you’ve all been eagerly waiting to visit the carnival since we last showed it off, and it will finally be accessible with this new update!

A New Friend!
In the last update, we introduced the relationship system with characters, and of course, we’ve added a new character in version 1.0! Meet Bombshell Barbara - a woman with an “explosive” personality who needs your help! Befriend her, help her work through her problems, and she’ll make sure nobody messes with you!

New Smart Tower Levels
We’ve added levels 3 and 4 of the Smart Tower, meaning you can now travel to every corner of Cosmopolis and visit all the previously locked locations! You’ll also be able to unlock new upgrade modules, including the weather control module, solar generator, and battery upgrades. And don’t forget the enhancements for minions, batteries, and tools. Get ready to explore!

Resource Progression
As technology advances, so do production methods. We’ve added a third level for the press, along with a nano-forge - a new structure where you can create entirely new materials like techno-wood, tungsten, carbon, and reactors! And, of course, you can now finally fully upgrade all your tools to the max level!

Teleports
The rooftop was already pretty big, and now it’s even bigger. Moving around has become a real issue, but we have a solution: teleportation. Place one here, place another there, and voilà! Now no one will be able to keep up, except maybe the game camera.

Farming, Fishing, and Cooking
New plants and crops have arrived - cream beans and noodle grass. And you thought the cheese tree was the height of Cosmopolis agriculture? You can now upgrade the fishing rod to level 3 to catch four new, delightful post-apocalyptic fish. And with all these new ingredients, we’re thrilled to announce the arrival of the fourth and final level of the kitchen, along with dozens of new recipes for you to try.

Progression
We’ve added all the missing structure levels: Level 2 and 3 for the Cultivator and UV Tower, Level 3 for the Bio-Generator, Crypto Farm, and anti-infection spray, and of course, Level 4 for the Barricade.

Recycling
A few words about our latest addition: recycling. We’ve expanded resource recycling in the game, with dismantling options now available on the workbench, farmer’s table, and synthesizer, including levels 2 and 3. All your “spam” resources (we promise we didn’t mean for them to be spam) are now integrated into the broader resource system. Pre-created resources can also be broken down into their components.

notes.title: 'Relationship' Major Content Update! 💕
notes.notes:
Hello, future-dwellers! 

Here's the update you’ve all been waiting for! At the Housewarming party, it didn't seem to go just as planned, so it's time to win back some trust and build more of a relationship with your fellow rooftop friends!

Explore a new rooftop
We have a new roof - the Entertainment Zone! Hotel guests would swim, exercise, sing, dance, and watch movies. We've even added new themed items to dismantle. Keep exploring to find a new cosmetic item 👀

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/cf1ab13e054cd02f11b6a4fe8ce8df49131604df.png

Continuation of the Main Storyline
The long-awaited continuation of the main storyline is here but where could we go after the housewarming party? 
Now we have the answer for you. Although the story is not yet finished we do have some surprises waiting to keep you guessing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/1dbdc0ba5709607821c979dcb01fc33d60f87d5c.png

Relationships
Develop relationships with your friends on the rooftop! After such a housewarming, it’s only natural that you'd want to cheer them up. As you develop relationships, you can give them gifts that you find on expeditions, play mini-games, and complete daily tasks! With each relationship level, new rewards will unlock for you.

The relationship system is our main focus for this update. We hope you will find it as exciting and fun to befriend a fridge as we did implementing it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/56846af14b2fb7449ff9da462723d3e67b837e53.png

Radio Module
Have you wondered why you communicate through the Smart Tower? We have an answer: now you can. Every day, you will discover lost messages from the residents of flooded Cosmopolis every day. Some will even talk back like the Game Master! More characters will be communicating in the future, so check back often.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/df96231424d7dd19a5b5397a2cc66c13677a0f12.png

New Smart Tower Modules
In this update, we’ve prepared a whole series of new modules. Starting with the long-awaited tool upgrades. Spend as little time as possible dismantling trash! 

Want to know the weather forecast? Install the weather forecast module.
Do your minions often run out of power? Increase their battery life! Speaking of our little helpers:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/c9dd55ac06ea9265dc9fb62a8ea5dd70156a649d.png

Minions
Speaking of our little robot minions, with every update, we give these cuties a significant dose of attention. We constantly work to improve the minion AI to make them smarter along with some new added features too:

 We have some new roles: The water carrier, aqua genius, and repairman. These minions will water the flower beds, refill the sprinklers, and repair your buildings.
 We’ve improved minion behavior and added statuses and custom routes.
 All minions, not just gatherers, can search for and collect resources from the ground. (It wasn't easy, but we finally did it!)  
 Idle minions will no longer waste energy.
 Last but not least, Minions will now complete tasks to the end! Sometimes, the goal is so far that the battery almost dies. Don’t worry - other minions have volunteered to help to the end and then go back to recharge.
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/a273201852669e1aac4884bb93b64eef83ef2326.png

And a Few More Small Changes

 We redesigned the floor patches to look more plastic. Many players suggested they should be made of planks, but we have other ideas. And, trust us, carrying hundreds of planks for all the patches would be extremely tiring.
 New resource - reactor.
 There are three levels of repair kits with new models and animations. Repair minions also use them – be sure to check them out!
 The water storage barrel has become an essential element of gameplay. We have moved it to the regular storage category. We will return everything to those who managed to buy it with coupons.

notes.title: 'Solar Energy' Major Content Update! 🚀
notes.notes:
What’s new?

[previewyoutube=MFTLwlQiTJk;full][/previewyoutube]
The new rooftop is available after completing the New Home quest. Exploring this rooftop will reveal the story of Muscle Claus, "the strongest" man in Cosmopolis.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/66e7156b2154d1304666ac31713f987b039fdfef.jpg

Solar generator and battery 🌞

Two structures that expand the game's electrical system. The solar generator operates without fuel but won't work at night or in dark weather. The battery helps preserve energy in the electrical grid, allowing for long-lasting autonomy. Together, they create a powerful grid that doesn't even need fuel.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/06fff21d96187e06fccaaf045a8d669898c73331.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/db0d0dda269543376a96614f2cc9cb4a287a0d86.gif

New tools 🔧

Level 3 drill and level 3 injector. These will help disassemble everything on the rooftop.
The automatic sprinkler and pump have been upgraded to level 3, and the water supply and irrigation system have received their long-awaited improvements.

Days of the week 📅

A week cycle has been added to the game. It diversifies the expedition system, with many points of interest now only open on certain days of the week. Conversely, the rewards at these points have been increased. Also, traders do not work on certain days of the week. But where do they go? They replenish their inventory. Track the days when traders and points of interest are available in the new character menu tab - the Calendar.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/c9e57d82e0ea5b0081bde4452ed2b6fe9da74b7e.gif

Weather ⛅

Another feature introduced to diversify the world of I Am Future is the weather cycle. Currently, overcast and rainy weather has been created. Each affects the rooftop. Mushrooms even grow during overcast weather. In rainy weather, you don't need to water the plants; the barrels automatically fill with fresh water. Remember to pour the saltwater first, as they don't mix well. However, rainy weather is considered dark for the solar generator and won't charge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/4aade83c6fdc5e35f7dd9ae16309cacdc5b9aecb.png

There is a new device to disassemble, but we suggest you find it yourself. Now, all devices that you disassemble may contain an unexpected find.

Wires across bridges and ladders ⚡

Remember how often you wrote that electrical grids from different rooftops couldn't be connected? Now they can! We've added a system of electrical poles on all ladders and the bridge. You just need to install them.

A chest in the fishing area 🎁 

Since everyone is tired of fishing trips, when you leave your rod at home, store it in the meta-network of chests and retrieve it even in the fishing zone. By the way, you can now build a special chest there. To avoid disassembling all household appliances on-site, they can now be lifted by an elevator.

Special bait for mollusks 

The second level of the fishing rod really expands the list of catches, which can negatively impact when you need to catch the most basic thing - mollusks. A special recipe at the workbench will create a bait that exclusively catches mollusks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/4e603f737d0823daa868c6509370ee9c9bf71be6.png

Cheese tree and tomato 🧀 

New rooftop - new plants. They expand the farming and cooking systems. Try 7 new recipes in our menu before the rest!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/06d2c6dba0901ba54bfb189f754164a99f6900c3.gif

Sports suit  🏓

The theme of the new rooftop is sports, so we had to add a sports suit.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/73bb26c1f3589f14bd38657f20352a4492f9ff1e.gif

Crafting buckets 💧

You can now craft as many buckets as you want at the workbench. They are more convenient to use than bottles.

A new navigation system for minions 🤖 

This is a big step towards making them the most helpful helpers. The minion navigation system is a huge task, and, of course, it is not perfect yet, but it is now working much faster and making fewer mistakes. We will also give it special attention in a future update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/d914548547d38dc772697e57c77c2de79d97efbc.gif

New hints ❓  

We placed hints throughout all the systems in the game on the loading screen so they are no longer empty. They were selected based on your feedback, which we truly appreciate! One of the frequent issues not explained in the game is where Agatha's shop is located. Now, it is highlighted on the map of expeditions, even at the first level of the smart tower.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/4839f96e45367064b60a909906a921aff11a3ba5.png

Additional fixes and improvements

Gameplay:
Added a hydraulic press mechanic to the workbench for splitting resources
Added upgrades for pumps, allowing them to collect and desalinate water automatically
Traders' assortments are now updated periodically
Fixed the moving of the barricades in nano-transports
Removed the loading screen when moving to the fishing zone by elevator

UI & Controls:
Improved gamepad control during the fishing
Improved the hint system for gamepads
Many UI and text fixes in the game
Made corrections to the control schemes for rotating the camera and large resources during the transportation 
Fish cutting can now be done continuously by holding down a button
Updated design of hints for points of interest in expeditions
Localization fixes in various languages

Optimization:
Fixed many bugs
Improved game performance
Improved and sped up the save and load system
Fixed errors in the direction of electricity in wires
Fixed collider errors in many places

Art:
Updated graphics for floor breaches
Added new unique illustrations for all points in expeditions
Many visual bug fixes

Sound:
Fixed hologram sounds
Added sounds for the molecular synthesizer
Added sounds for healing
Added sounds for splitting resources
Added sounds for the infection flowers

notes.title: 🚀 'A New Me' Content Update 💙
notes.notes:
It's finally here future-dwellers! 🚀

The holiday season is still celebrated even in a post-apocalyptic world! We are pleased to present you! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/518a76488a47059bfd73e0a63c7f22259ed33655.gif

The team has been working tirelessly and reading all of your requests of what content you want to see next as well as improvements to our game. We are finally able to say, it's here and we can't wait for you all to play it.

Make sure you don't miss our Christmas Event! We have some special presents waiting for you on our rooftop 🎁

This event runs from Dec 21st - Jan 10th and all items you obtain will be yours to keep forever so make sure you jump back to your rooftop and get these limited-time items today

Check out our video here for all the details and what to expect 👇:

[previewyoutube=lQw02VuFaMI;full][/previewyoutube]
We've had a challenging year at Mandragora as we released our game into Early Access but your positive feedback we've received from our amazing players has kept us going. 

We're also working on making the game compatible with gamepads, which will be available soon. We know this is a highly requested addition to our game and we're working on it as we speak but we just need a little more time. 

Major Content Updates:

All new female character AND customization options

The female character is now in the game right now! You can only choose a character once per game, but we didn't want our long-time players to miss out on this exciting update. The first time you click 'continue' on the main menu, you will be presented with a choice! New players will see it immediately when starting a new game.

We've also added more customization options to our editor, including skin color, hair, eyebrows, and beard.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/82df3b298f784de422d44e482fce5013b55ae320.gif

New decorative buildings & mechanics

You'll love the new functional buildings that let you nap in style, store tons of one-type resources, and tables that will allow you to arrange items or serve yourself lunch!

We also have added new footpaths that can make your rooftop all that more unique to you and of course, cozy like you're on a small country farm.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/8e6b0b41a1f657aa1a6a43d0b72eebe6ec34568f.png

Color your rooftop!

You can now craft spray cans from leech slime and decorate all your buildings in various colors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/ffed88be19476776979a276345fab17f4166560e.png

Blocking the infection nests

Annoyed by those pesky leeches from getting to your resources? We have added a special dome that can block them, just simply installed it on the huge flower.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/1c4a2b76ed88d22ca5fea0518c895834222e92ba.gif

Rooftop Patches

Sealing holes in the floor is now available with special patches. Once the floor is sealed, you can finally walk AND build on it so you know it's sturdy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/874215e48076e695c8f251be027c57e9a062c3f4.png

Introduction to 'mini-tasks' and new currency

We have added all new "mini-tasks" Complete them to earn new currency which you can spend at a new store during expeditions to buy useful items and furniture blueprints.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/adcdcc33d777a6e0450c2018319db334fa4c48d2.png

Christmas Event

Of course, we wanted to get you all into the holiday spirit with some gifts! Just launch the game and you'll find them on your rooftop, ready to bring some extra holiday cheer to your day!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/c50b280a3727d6023ecf277c1efc0374f7ff3e9d.png
Improvements and fixes:

 Fixed minion painting mask
 Improved minion performance
 Added a new music track for fishing
 Improved character controller
 Optimized leeches' "brains"
 Items on stage can now be disassembled
 Fixed an issue with the quest for the automatic sprinkler
 New interface for the Ecomate and the store in expeditions
 New objects added to the library
 Fixed generator interface
 "Put all resources in storage" button
 Improved performance at night
 Improved performance of electrical networks
 Numerous character customization fixes
 Bug fixes and overall game stability improvements

We have some pretty incredible updates planned for next year, and we can't wait to share them with you. For now, we hope you have a wonderful holiday season with your loved ones, and we'll see you in the future. Merry Christmas!

notes.title: Patch Notes: 📬 Version: 0.3.4.042r
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Our team is doing our best to combine work on new content and improvements to the existing features. 

In this patch, we've addressed several pesky issues that some players may have encountered during gameplay (such as problems with the day and night cycle, which caused one of the initial quests not to be completed) 

We also didn't miss the opportunity to improve the behavior of minions and fix other issues. And the second roof is now even more beautiful! :) 

Thank you so much for reporting bugs, providing feedback, and leaving inspiring reviews for our game! With your input, I Am Future is getting better every day!

Here’s the list of changes for today’s update:

Minions 🤖

 Improved behavior and navigation for the Technician and Builder roles.
 Enhanced target search algorithm for the Collector role.
 Fixed minion behavior algorithm during recharge.
 Fixed an issue where minions became the default color upon loading, even if a different color was set before.
 Fixed a minor bug with the outline of interactive objects in minion target assignment mode.

UI & Controls 🎮

 Improved storage interfaces.
 Fixed the behavior of pressing Escape in the expedition code lock and at the trader.
 Fixed the fuel level interface in the kitchen.
 Now the watering zone for automatic sprinklers is displayed during construction, as well as the range of the Ultraviolet Tower's impact, and the connection zone for electric poles.
 Fixed a bug when transitioning from the pause menu to the main menu.

Gameplay👾

 Fixed a serious error that prevented the game from continuing (the player would stuck in the endless day) when removing the leech with a full inventory.
 Fixed the ladder collider on the first roof.
 Fixed the operation of the StopWeed Spray.
 Fixed a bug with falling through the floor under electric poles and sources of infection.
 Fish soup moved from the Drinks section to the Food section (no one knows who put it in drinks, maybe it was too liquid for food.

Graphics 📺

 Significant improvement of textures for the second roof.
 Shader improvement for the hologram of the Generator construction.
 Fixed the operation of lamps for improved beds.
 Added animation for the resource creation press.
 Fixed the position of the molecular synthesizer model.
 Fixed holograms when moving bushes and trees with a nano-transporter.

Sound 🔊

 Restored the missing sound of throwing resources into a construction.
 Fixed sounds when dismantling household appliances.

Stability 📈

 Bug fixes and overall game stability improvements

 The crashed plane diorama bug that allowed interacting with Mariquinn prematurely is fixed.
 The infamous resource stacking bug resulted in having a tower of planks and other resources is fixed.
 You can’t now duplicate items in the storage.
 Sprinkler returns empty bottles back to the player.
 You can’t build around the broken stairs anymore.
 The Hammer won’t get unnoticed after you buy it in ECOmate now.
 Some NPC dialogues that were incorrectly used after you brought them to your base have been fixed.


Balance

 You can get more various items from fishing now.
 You can get more various items from the “weeds” drop.
 You starve slower now.
 The minion learning recipe now doesn’t have “Programmable Core”, but got the ink and a paper.
 The Cryptofarm balance has been updated.
 Traders - Stan offers mushrooms and Agatha offers potatoes only after you find the mushrooms and potatoes on the roof.
 More fuel capacity for the improved Field Kitchen. 


Graphics

 The stroke settings for plants on the map have been improved.
 A clipping of large resources has been fixed.
 The tickets that you find in the crashed plane location now have a bigger resolution for better readability.
 Electric poles won’t spam sparkles anymore.


Audio

 Fixed a bug where the background music would stop playing after completing the quest line.


UI

 Updated icons: Water Pump, Injector tool (lvl 1), Saw tool (lvl 2), and the “Rocket” (narrative object)
 Updated building upgrade window.
 Localization bugs have been updated.
 Fixed a bug when clicking on the float (fishing) was not counted.
 Fixed bug with missing Press in the "Library" section.
 Fixed a bug where after splitting a stack of resources, the cell where the split was, remained highlighted.
 Adjusted the display of items in the "Library" section.
 Adjustments in the layout of the "Manage Minion" window.
 Adjustments in the layout of the "Storage" window.
 The library now shows only those tutorials that the player has already seen.
 Added fishing tips (line, and strong line)
 Fixed display of prices in ECOmate.
 Added automatic closing of the split stack window if the storage window was closed.
 Fixed a number of bugs related to stuck markers.
 Other minor UI fixes and improvements.


Other Fixes

 Fixed a number of bugs that could cause the game to crash on the loading screen.
 Fixed the playing of the power grid dialogue after reloading the game.
 When connecting electricity through the poles, the quest would not close.
 Chair interaction bug fixed (how did you even find that chair?)
 The disappearance of a sheet of iron, if thrown in the technical area, is fixed.
 Overflowing inventory of the drone broke expeditions and it was impossible to fly anywhere.
 After rearranging inventory items on an expedition, it was impossible to fly to any point of interest.
 The button to open an item from a merchant would not work after receiving it on the roof.
 At certain positions of the camera and mouse, the choice between two interactive objects would switch inconsistently.
 Fixed the order of actions for cutting wood and metal in the fence.
 Zoo and Abandoned Bus Stop gave only half the reward from what was promised on the global map.
 When buying several digital vaults on an expedition with one free slot in the inventory, it was possible to lose some of the purchased items.
 Minions stopped entering the built bridge after saving/loading.

notes.notes:
This patch includes changes made to the demo as a result of the active feedback from the community. We would really like to thank everyone who played our demo and shared their feedback, comments and suggestions!
 
 BUG FIXES
 * ❗ A bug where access to the item storage for Earl’s fridge items disappeared has been fixed.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/d3513665d943f1a862cf4fba0b61b76f50a22fbe.png
 
 * ❗ The save system has been reworked and compatibility with previous save files has been ensured. Players who encounter the above issue related to Earl’s storage should have access to it again.{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41188590/d3513665d943f1a862cf4fba0b61b76f50a22fbe.png 
 
 * A bug affecting a quest that is impossible to complete related to the Programmable Core has been fixed.
 * A bug that made bushes remain empty without fruit after loading a game has been fixed.
* A bug where leeches would live during the daytime has been fixed.
 * A bug in the Fishing Mode Tutorial has been fixed.
 * A bug that made the wrong blueprint for the Press building appear on the Workbench has been fixed;
* A bug where the time would save incorrectly while elapsed has been fixed.
 
 BALANCE
 * The Storage Blueprint is now given to the player from the start of the game.
 
 INTERFACE
 * Various interface improvements in Expedition Mode.
 * Various improvements to untranslatable inscriptions.
 * The font and its size in the Health and Hunger parameters have been fixed.
 * The object interaction area is now drawn on top of all objects.
 * The yellow “New Item” identifier in the menu categories has been fixed.
 
 TEXT
 * The character monologues by the UV Tower and cryopod have been fixed.
 * The mistake in the name of the Big Bugeye has been fixed.
 
 LOCALIZATION
 * The texts in various languages have been updated! Thanks to the players for their comments!
 
 SOUNDS
 * The fishing sounds have been improved.
 * The customization window sounds have been improved.
 * The Expedition Mode sounds have been improved.
 * The Drill and Elevator sounds have been improved.
 
 OTHER
 * Various fixes to improve game stability.

EARLY ACCESS | MAY 18TH

Hey there, everyone! The excitement is off the charts for us today: we finally have a release date for I Am Future. The game will come out in Early Access on May 18th.

Get your eyes on a new sing-along trailer:

[previewyoutube=hnh3jwkIl4s;full][/previewyoutube]

You may ask: "Why did you folks decide to go with the "Early Access launch" option?". Since we started working on I Am Future in 2020, we have constantly iterated together with our players. After organizing numerous closed tests and releasing a public demo, we've realized that witnessing players interacting with the game and improving it based on feedback is something we enjoy the most.

We can't wait to bring the game to all of you this spring. Meanwhile, the plan is to keep our community posted with regular devlogs. Follow our page to stay updated!
